s.d: κατα-βαρύνω [in LXX: [[2-kings 13 25|2Ki.13:25 14:26]] (כָּבַד), [[joel 2 8|Jol.2:8]], Sir.8:15 * ;] = καταβαρέω: pass., Pres. ptcp., [[mark 14 40|Mrk.14:40.]]† (AS)

κατα-βιβάζω [in LXX for יָרַד (hi., etc.): [[deuteronomy 21 4|Deu.21:4]], [[ezekiel 31 16|Eze.31:16]], al. ;] to cause to go down, cast down: pass., ἕως ᾅδου, [[matthew 11 23|Mat.11:23]] (WH, R, mg.), [[luke 10 15|Luk.10:15]] (WH, mg.).† (AS)

κατα-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ (καταβάλλω), [in LXX: 2Ma.2:29 * ;] 1. a laying down: εἰς κ. σπέρματος, [[hebrews 11 11|Heb.11:11]] (EV, to conceive seed). 2. a foundation (of a house, ii Mac, l.with): metaphorically, ἀπὸ κ. κόσμου, [[matthew 13 35|Mat.13:35]] (LXX) (om. ἀπὸ κ. κόσμου, WH, R, mg.), [[matthew 25 34|Mat.25:34]], [[luke 11 50|Luk.11:50]], [[hebrews 4 3|Heb.4:3 9:26]], [[revelation 13 8|Rev.13:8 17:8]]; πρὸ κ. κόσμου, [[john 17 24|Jhn.17:24]], [[ephesians 1 4|Eph.1:4]], [[1-peter 1 20|1Pe.1:20]].† (AS)
κατα-βραβεύω (βραβεύς, an umpire, cf βραβεῖον) to give judg­ment against, condemn (see Field, Notes, 196; Abbott, Essays, 104 f.): [[colossians 2 18|Col.2:18.]]† (AS)
καταγγελεύς, -έως, ὁ a proclaimer, herald (in Inscr., κ. ἀγώνων, Deiss., LAE, 97): with genitive obj., [[acts 17 18|Act.17:18.]]† (AS)

κατ-αγγέλλω [in LXX: [[proverbs 17 5|Pro.17:5]] A, 2Ma.8:36 2Mac 9:17 * ;] 1. to pro­claim, declare: with accusative of thing(s), [[acts 3 24|Act.3:24 16:21 17:23]]; τ. ἀνάστασιν, [[acts 4 2|Act.4:2;]] τ. λόγον τοῦ Θ., τ. Κ., [[acts 13 5|Act.13:5 15:36]]; ὁδὸν σωτηρίας, [[acts 16 17|Act.16:17;]] φῶς, [[acts 26 23|Act.26:23;]] τ. μυστήριον τοῦ Θ., [[1-corinthians 2 1|1Co.2:1;]] τ. εὐαγγέλιον, [[1-corinthians 9 14|1Co.9:14;]] τ. θάνατον τοῦ Κ., [[1-corinthians 11 26|1Co.11:26;]] pass., ἄφεσις, [[acts 13 33|Act.13:33;]] ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θ., [[acts 17 13|Act.17:13;]] ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν, [[romans 1 8|Rom.1:8;]] with accusative of person(s), of Christ, ὅν, [[acts 17 3|Act.17:3]], [[colossians 1 28|Col.1:28]]; τ. Χριστόν, [[philippians 1 17|Php.1:17;]] pass., [[philippians 1 18|Php.1:18.]] 2. to denounce (Xen., al.); (for comparison with ἀγγέλλω, ἀναγ-, ἀπαγ-, see Westc. on [[1-john 1 5|1Jn.1:5;]] and cf. προ-καταγγέλλω).† (AS)

κατα-γελάω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for שָׂחַק, [[job 5 22|Job.5:22]], [[proverbs 29 9|Pro.29:9]], al. ;] to deride, laugh scornfully at: with genitive of person(s), [[matthew 9 24|Mat.9:24]], [[mark 5 40|Mrk.5:40]], [[luke 8 53|Luk.8:53]].† (AS)

κατα-γινώσκω (see: γινώσκω), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 25 1|Deu.25:1]] (רָשַׁע hi.), [[proverbs 28 11|Pro.28:11]] (חָקַר), Sir.14:2 19:5 * ;] to blame, condemn: with genitive of person(s), [[1-john 3 20|1Jn.3:20-21;]] pass., κατεγνωσμένος ἦν (RV, he stood condemned, see Ellie., in l; but cf. Field, Notes, 188): [[galatians 2 11|Gal.2:11.]]† (AS)
κατ-άγνυμι [in LXX for נָחַת pi., etc. ;] to break: with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 12 20|Mat.12:20]] (LXX), [[john 19 31|Jhn.19:31-33.]]† (AS)

κατ-άγω [in LXX chiefly for יָרַד hi. ;] to bring down: with accusative of person(s), [[acts 22 30|Act.22:30]], [[romans 10 6|Rom.10:6]]; id. before εἰς, [[acts 9 30|Act.9:30 23:15, 20 23:28]]; as nautical term, to bring to land: τ. πλοῖον ἐπὶ τ. γῆν, [[luke 5 11|Luk.5:11;]] pass., before εἰς, [[acts 27 3|Act.27:3 2:12]].† (AS)
κατ-αγωνίζομαι depon., "perfective" compound (M, Pr., 116); 1. to struggle against. 2. to conquer, overcome: [[hebrews 11 33|Heb.11:33.]]† (AS)
κατα-δέω, -ῶ [in LXX for חָבַשׁ, etc. ;] to bind up: τ. τραύματα (cf. Sir.27:21), [[luke 10 34|Luk.10:34]].† (AS)
κατά-δηλος, -ον (δὴλος) quite manifest, evident: [[hebrews 7 15|Heb.7:15.]]† (AS)

κατα-δικάζω [in LXX: [[psalms 94 21|Psa.94:21]] (רָשַׁע hi.), [[lamentations 3 36|La 3:36]] (עָוַת pi.), Wis.2:20, al. ;] to pass sentence upon, condemn; in cl., with genitive of person(s) (accusative of thing(s)); in late writers (so LXX), with accusative of person(s) (θανάτῳ, Wis, l.with): [[matthew 12 7|Mat.12:7]], [[james 5 6|Jas.5:6]]; absol. (as Plat., Legg., 958c), [[luke 6 37|Luk.6:37;]] pass., [[matthew 12 37|Mat.12:37]], [[luke 6 37|Luk.6:37]].† δικάζω, to judge: [[luke 6 37|Luk.6:37]] (Tr., mg.; see: καταδ-; Cremer, 199).† (AS)

κατα-διώκω [in LXX chiefly for רָדַף ;] "perfective" compound (M, Pr., 116), to pursue closely, follow up (a) with hostile intent (Thuc., i, 49, [[genesis 31 36|Gen.31:36]] al.); (b) with kindly intention ([[psalms 23 6|Psa.23:6]], [[1-samuel 30 22|1Ki.30:22]], cf. Sir.27:17): [[mark 1 36|Mrk.1:36]].† (AS)
κατα-δουλόω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for עָבַד ;] to enslave: [[2-corinthians 11 20|2Co.11:20]], [[galatians 2 4|Gal.2:4]].† (AS)

κατα-δυναστεύω [in LXX for יָנָה, עָשַׁק, etc. ;] to exercise power over, oppress: with accusative of person(s) (Xen.; LXX, [[micah 2 2|Mic.2:2]], Wis.2:10, al.); with genitive of person(s), [[james 2 6|Jas.2:6]] (ὑμᾶς, T); pass., [[acts 10 38|Act.10:38]] (cf. MM, Exp., xv).† (AS)

κατ-αισχύνω [in LXX chiefly for בּוּשׁ ;] to disgrace, dishonour, put to shame: with accusative of thing(s), [[1-corinthians 11 4|1Co.11:4-5;]] with accusative of person(s), [[1-corinthians 1 27|1Co.1:27 11:22]]; pass., to be ashamed: [[luke 13 17|Luk.13:17]], [[2-corinthians 7 14|2Co.7:14 9:4]], [[1-peter 3 16|1Pe.3:16]]; as in LXX ([[psalms 22 6|Psa.22:6 25:2-3]], al.), of unfulfilled hopes: [[romans 5 5|Rom.5:5;]] pass., [[romans 9 33|Rom.9:33 10:11]], [[1-peter 2 6|1Pe.2:6]]" (LXX) .† (AS)

κατα-καίω [in LXX chiefly for שָׂרַף; in [[exodus 3 2|Exo.3:2]] (אָכַל pu.), distinguished from καίω ;] to burn up, burn completely: with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 13 30|Mat.13:30]] [[acts 19 19|Act.19:19]]; pass., [[1-corinthians 3 15|1Co.3:15]], [[hebrews 13 11|Heb.13:11]], [[2-peter 3 10|2Pe.3:10]], [[revelation 8 7|Rev.8:7]]; before πυρί [[matthew 3 12|Mat.3:12 13:40]], [[luke 3 17|Luk.3:17]] (cf. [[exodus 29 14|Exo.29:14]], al.); ἐν πυρί ([[deuteronomy 9 21|Deu.9:21]], al.): [[revelation 17 16|Rev.17:16 18:8]].† (AS)
κατα-καλύπτω [in LXX chiefly for כָּסָה pi. ;] to cover up; mid., to cover or veil oneself: [[1-corinthians 11 6|1Co.11:6;]] τ. κεφαλήν, [[1-corinthians 11 7|1Co.11:7.]]† (AS)

κατα-καυχάομαι, -ῶμαι [in LXX: [[zechariah 10 12|Zec.10:12]] (הָלַךְ hith.), [[jeremiah 50 11|Jer.50:11]] (עָלַז), [[jeremiah 50 38|Jer.50:38]] (הָלַל)* ;] 1. to boast against, exult over: with genitive, [[romans 11 18|Rom.11:18]], [[james 2 13|Jas.2:13]]; before κατά, with genitive, [[james 3 14|Jas.3:14]] (T, om. κατά). 2. before ἐν, to glory in (Za., l.with, [[jeremiah 27 38|Jer.27:38]]).† (AS)

κατά-κειμαι [in LXX: [[proverbs 6 9|Pro.6:9 23:34]] (שָׁכַב), Jdth.13:15, Wis.17:7 * ;] 1. to lie down. 2. to lie sick: [[mark 1 30|Mrk.1:30 2:4]], [[john 5 6|Jhn.5:6]], [[acts 28 8|Act.28:8]]; before ἐπί with genitive, [[acts 9 33|Act.9:33;]] id. with accusative, [[luke 5 25|Luk.5:25;]] ἐν, [[john 5 3|Jhn.5:3.]] 3. to recline at meals (cf. ἀνάιειμαι): [[mark 14 3|Mrk.14:3]], [[luke 5 29|Luk.5:29]]; before ἐν, [[mark 2 15|Mrk.2:15]], [[luke 7 37|Luk.7:37]], [[1-corinthians 8 10|1Co.8:10]].† (AS)
κατα-κλάω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[ezekiel 19 12|Eze.19:12]] (נָתַשׁ hoph.)* ;] to break up, break in pieces: [[mark 6 41|Mrk.6:41]], [[luke 9 16|Luk.9:16]].† (AS)

κατα-κλείω [in LXX: [[jeremiah 32 3|Jer.32:3]] (כָּלָא), Wis.17:2, 16, 2Ma.13:21, 3Ma.3:25 * ;] to shut up:. with accusative of person(s), before ἐν φυλακῇ (-αῖς), [[luke 3 20|Luk.3:20]], [[acts 26 10|Act.26:10]].† (AS)

κατα-κληρονομέω, -ῶ [in LXX for נָחַל, יָרַשׁ, etc. ;] 1. to distribute by lot or as an inheritance ([[numbers 34 18|Num.34:18]], [[joshua 14 1|Jos.14:1]], al.): [[acts 13 19|Act.13:19]]. 2. to receive by inheritance ([[deuteronomy 1 38|Deu.1:38]], al.).† κατα-κληροδοτέω, ῶ, [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 1 38|Deu.1:38 21:16]] A (-νομέω, B), (נָחַל), 1Ma.3:36 א R (-νομέω, A)* ;] [[acts 13 19|Act.13:19]], Rec., = -νομέω, which see† (AS)

κατα-κλίνω [in LXX: [[exodus 21 18|Exo.21:18]] (נָפַל), [[numbers 24 9|Num.24:9]], [[judges 5 27|Jdg.5:27]], [[1-samuel 16 11|1Ki.16:11]] (כָּרַע), Jdth.12:15, 3Ma.1:3 * ;] to lay down, make to lie down, esp. for meals: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 9 14|Luk.9:14-15;]] mid., to recline at meals: [[luke 7 36|Luk.7:36 24:30]]; before εἰς, [[luke 14 8|Luk.14:8]] (cf. Jth, Lc.).† (AS)
κατα-κλύζω [in LXX for שָׁטַף, [[psalms 78 20|Psa.78:20]], al. ;] to inundate, deluge: pass., [[2-peter 3 6|2Pe.3:6.]]† (AS)

κατα-κλυσμός, -οῦ, ὁ (κατακλύζω), [in LXX chiefly for מַבּוּל, [[genesis 6 17|Gen.6:17]], al.; also for שֶׁטֶף, [[psalms 32 6|Psa.32:6]], al. ;] a flood, deluge: [[matthew 24 38|Mat.24:38-39]] [[luke 17 27|Luk.17:27]], [[2-peter 2 5|2Pe.2:5]].† (AS)
κατ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[jeremiah 17 16|Jer.17:16]] (רָאָה), 1Ma.6:23, al. ;] to follow after: [[luke 23 55|Luk.23:55;]] with dative of person(s), [[acts 16 17|Act.16:17.]]† (AS)

κατα-κόπτω [in LXX for נָכָה hi., כָּתַת pi., etc. ;] to cut up, cut in pieces (cf. [[isaiah 27 9|Isa.27:9]], [[jeremiah 21 7|Jer.21:7]], [[2-chronicles 34 7|2Ch.34:7]]): ἑαυτὸν λίθοις, [[mark 5 5|Mrk.5:5.]]† (AS)
κατα-κρημνίζω (κρημνός), [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 25 12|2Ch.25:12]] (שָׁלַךְ hi.), 2Ma.12:15 2Mac 14:43, 4Ma.4:25*.] to throw over a precipice, cast down head­long: [[luke 4 29|Luk.4:29.]]† (AS)
κατά-κριμα, -τος, τό (κατακρίνω), penalty (RV, condemnation; but cf. Deiss., BS, 264 f.; MM, Exp., xv): [[romans 5 16|Rom.5:16, 18 8:1]].† (AS)

κατα-κρίνω [in LXX: [[esther 2 1|Est.2:1]] (גָּזַר ni.), Wis.4:16, Dan LXX TH Sus 1:53, 4:34, TH Sus 1:41,48,53* ;] to give judgment against, condemn: [[romans 8 34|Rom.8:34;]] with accusative of person(s), [[mark 14 64|Mrk.14:64]], [[john 8 10|Jhn.8:10-11]]; disting. fr. κρίνειν, [[romans 2 1|Rom.2:1]], [[1-corinthians 11 32|1Co.11:32]]; before θανάτῳ (cl. -ου or -ον), [[matthew 20 18|Mat.20:18]], [[mark 10 33|Mrk.10:33]]; pass., [[matthew 27 3|Mat.27:3]], [[mark 16 16|Mrk.16:16]], [[romans 14 23|Rom.14:23]], [[1-corinthians 11 32|1Co.11:32]], [[2-peter 2 6|2Pe.2:6]]. Metaphorical, of condemning through a good example: [[matthew 12 41|Mat.12:41-42]], [[luke 11 31|Luk.11:31-32]], [[romans 8 3|Rom.8:3]], [[hebrews 11 7|Heb.11:7]] † (AS)
κατά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ (κατακρίνω), condemnation: [[2-corinthians 3 9|2Co.3:9 7:3]] (cf. Deiss., LAE, 91 f.).† (AS)

κατα-κυριεύω [in LXX: [[genesis 1 28|Gen.1:28]] (כָּבַשׁ), [[psalms 110 2|Psa.110:2]] Sir.17:4, al. ;] to gain or exercise dominion (over); (a) absol. (Arist.); (b) with genitive (Arist., al.): [[matthew 20 25|Mat.20:25]], [[mark 10 42|Mrk.10:42]], [[acts 19 16|Act.19:16]], [[1-peter 5 3|1Pe.5:3]].† SYN.: (κατεξουσιάζω) (see Swete, Mk., l.with) (AS)

κατα-λαλέω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for דָבַר ni., pi. ;] to speak evil of, rail at: in cl., with accusative; in LXX, (a) with genitive, (b) before κατά, with genitive; in NT, with genitive (M, Pr., 65): [[james 4 11|Jas.4:11]], [[1-peter 2 12|1Pe.2:12]]; pass., [[1-peter 3 16|1Pe.3:16]],† (AS)
κατα-λαλιά, -ᾶς, ἡ (κατάλαλος), [in LXX: Wis.1:11 * ;] evil-speaking, railing: p1., [[2-corinthians 12 20|2Co.12:20]], [[1-peter 2 1|1Pe.2:1]].† (AS)
κατά-λαλος, -ου, ὁ a railer, defamer: [[romans 1 30|Rom.1:30.]]† SYN.: (ψιθυριστής), a whisperer (see Tr., Syn., § cvii, 15; Lft., Notes, 256) (AS)

κατα-λαμβάνω [in LXX for נָשַׂג hi., לָכַד, etc. ;] 1. to lap hold of, seize, appropriate: [[mark 9 18|Mrk.9:18;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[1-corinthians 9 24|1Co.9:24]], [[philippians 3 12|Php.3:12-13]] 2. to overtake: as carrel, of διώκω (Field, Notes, 158 f.), [[romans 9 30|Rom.9:30;]] ἡ ἡμέρα, [[1-thessalonians 5 4|1Th.5:4;]] of evils, [[john 1 5|Jhn.1:5 12:35]] (cf. 617 T); hence, to surprise, discover: [[john 8 3|Jhn.8:3-4]]], 3. Of mental action, to apprehend, comprehend; so mid., in NT (M, Pr., 158): [[ephesians 3 18|Eph.3:18;]] before ὅτι, [[acts 4 13|Act.4:13 10:34]]; with accusative and inf., [[acts 25 25|Act.25:25]] (MM, Exp., xv).† (AS)

κατα-λέγω [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 19 16|Deu.19:16]] (עָנָה), 2Ma.7:30 R * ;] 1. to lay down; mid. (in Hom.), to lie down. 2. to narrate (LXX, ll. with). 3. to choose out, hence, to enrol (as of soldiers, Hdt., Thuc., a1., see LS, see word): of widows, pass., [[1-timothy 5 9|1Ti.5:9]] (cf. Ellic.; CGT, in l).† (AS)
κατά-λειμμα, -τος, τό (καταλείπω), [in LXX far שָׁאַר ([[isaiah 10 22|Isa.10:22 14:22]]), שְׁאֵרִית, etc. ;] a remnant: [[romans 9 27|Rom.9:27]], Rec. (for ὑπόλειμμα, which see).† (AS)

κατα-λείπω [in LXX chiefly far שָׁאַר, ni., hi., also for עָזַב, יָתַר, etc. ;] 1 1, to leave behind, leave: with accusative of person(s) (of thing(s)), [[matthew 4 13|Mat.4:13]], [[mark 12 19|Mrk.12:19, 21]], [[luke 20 31|Luk.20:31]], [[acts 24 27|Act.24:27 25:14]], [[hebrews 11 27|Heb.11:27]]; of sailing by a place, [[acts 21 3|Act.21:3;]] ptcp., καταλιπών, redundant (Dalman, Words, 21 f.), [[matthew 16 4|Mat.16:4 21:17]]; pass., [[john 8 9|Jhn.8:9]], [[1-thessalonians 3 1|1Th.3:1]]; metaphorically, εὐθεῖαν ὁδόν, [[2-peter 2 15|2Pe.2:15.]] 2. to forsake, abandon: [[matthew 19 5|Mat.19:5]], [[mark 10 7|Mrk.10:7]]" (LXX) [[mark 14 52|Mrk.14:52]], [[luke 5 28|Luk.5:28 15:4]], [[acts 6 2|Act.6:2]], [[ephesians 5 31|Eph.5:31]]" (LXX) . 3. to leave remaining, reserve: with accusative and inf., [[luke 10 40|Luk.10:40;]] ἐμαυτῷ, [[romans 11 4|Rom.11:4]] (LXX); pass., [[hebrews 4 1|Heb.4:1]] (cf. ἐν-κατα-λείπω).† (AS)
κατα-λιθάζω (= cl. -θόω; cf. -θοβολέω, [[exodus 17 4|Exo.17:4]], Num_14:10) to cast stones at, to stone: [[luke 20 6|Luk.20:6.]]† (AS)

κατ-αλλαγή, -ῆς, ἡ (καταλλάσσω), [in LXX: [[isaiah 9 5|Isa.9:5]](4), 2Ma.5:20 * ;] 1. exchange. 2. reconciliation: [[romans 5 11|Rom.5:11;]] κ. κόσμου, [[romans 11 15|Rom.11:15;]] διακονία τῆς κ., [[2-corinthians 5 18|2Co.5:18;]] λόγος τῆς κ., [[2-corinthians 5 19|2Co.5:19.]]† (AS)

κατ-αλλάσσω (Att.. -ττω; cf. ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX: [[jeremiah 48 39|Jer.48:39]] (חָתַת), 2Ma.1:5 2Mac 7:33 2Mac 8:29 * ;] prop., to change, exchange (esp. of money); hence, of persons, to change from emnity to friendship, to reconcile (for exx. in cl., see Thayer„ LS): of the reconciliation of man to God (Lft., Notes, 288; ICC on Ro, l.with; DCG, ii, 474, 797), [[2-corinthians 5 18|2Co.5:18-19;]] pass [[romans 5 10|Rom.5:10]], [[2-corinthians 5 20|2Co.5:20]]; of a woman returning to her husband, [[1-corinthians 7 11|1Co.7:11]] (cf. ἀπο-καταλλάσσω).† (AS)
κατά-λοιπος, -ον [in LXX for שָׁאַר, שְׁאֵרִית, יָתַר, etc. ;] left remaining: ἱο κ. τ. ἀνθρώπων, [[acts 15 17|Act.15:17]] (LXX).† (AS)

κατά-λυμα, -τος, τό (καταλύω), [in LXX: [[exodus 4 24|Exo.4:24]] (מָלוֹן), [[1-samuel 9 22|1Ki.9:22]] (לִשְׁכָּה), etc. ;] 1. = cl. καταγώγιον (cf. πανδοχεῖον), an inn, lodgingplace: [[luke 2 7|Luk.2:7]] (so Ex, l.with, and MGr.). 2. a guest-room (1Sam,l.with): [[mark 14 14|Mrk.14:14]], [[luke 22 11|Luk.22:11]].† (AS)

κατα-λύω [in LXX for לוּן, שָׁבַת, etc. ;] 1. to destroy, cast down: [[matthew 24 2|Mat.24:2]], [[mark 13 2|Mrk.13:2]], [[luke 21 6|Luk.21:6]]; τ. ναόν, [[matthew 26 61|Mat.26:61 27:40]], [[mark 14 58|Mrk.14:58 15:29]], [[acts 6 14|Act.6:14]]; οἰκίαν, [[2-corinthians 5 1|2Co.5:1;]] opposite to οἰκοδομεῖν, [[galatians 2 18|Gal.2:18.]] Metaphorical, to overthrow, annul, abrogate: [[acts 5 38|Act.5:38-39;]] τ. ἔργον τ. θεοῦ, [[romans 14 20|Rom.14:20;]] τ. νόμον, [[matthew 5 17|Mat.5:17]] (2Ma.2:22). 2. to unloose, unyoke (e.g. horses), hence intrans., of travellers (cf. κατάλυμα), to take up one's quarters, lodge (cl., [[genesis 19 2|Gen.19:2]], al.): [[luke 9 12|Luk.9:12 19:7]].† (AS)

κατα-μανθάνω [in LXX: [[genesis 34 1|Gen.34:1]] (רָאָה), [[job 35 4|Job.35:4]] (5) (שׁוּר), Sir.9:5, 8, al. ;] to learn thoroughly, observe well, consider carefully (on distinction bet. κ. and μανθάνω, cf. M, Pr., 117): [[matthew 6 28|Mat.6:28.]]† (AS)

κατα-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[job 15 6|Job.15:6]], [[proverbs 25 18|Pro.25:18]] (עָנָה), al. ;] to bear witness againt: with accusative of thing(s) and genitive of person(s), [[matthew 26 62|Mat.26:62 27:13]], [[mark 14 60|Mrk.14:60]].† (AS)
κατα-μένω [in LXX for יָשַׁב ([[numbers 20 1|Num.20:1]], al.), etc. ;] to remain permanently, abide: [[acts 1 13|Act.1:13]], [[1-corinthians 16 6|1Co.16:6]], WH (παραμ-, T, EV).† (AS)

καταμόνας Rec. for κατὰ μόνας, see: μόνος μόνος, -η, -ον, [in LXX chiefly for לְבַד ;] 1. adj., alone, solitary, forsaken: with verb., [[matthew 14 23|Mat.14:23]], [[mark 6 47|Mrk.6:47]], [[luke 9 36|Luk.9:36]], al.; with pron., [[matthew 18 15|Mat.18:15]], [[mark 9 2|Mrk.9:2]], al.; with subst., [[mark 9 8|Mrk.9:8]], [[luke 4 8|Luk.4:8]], al.; pleonast., οὐκ . . . εἰ μὴ μ., [[matthew 12 4|Mat.12:4]], [[luke 6 4|Luk.6:4]], al.; attrib., only, (ὁ) μ. θεός, [[john 5 44|Jhn.5:44 17:3]], [[romans 16 27|Rom.16:27]], [[1-timothy 1 17|1Ti.1:17]], Ju 25. 2. As adv., (a) neut., (μόνον, alone, only: referring to verb or predic., [[matthew 9 21|Mat.9:21]], [[mark 5 36|Mrk.5:36]], [[james 1 22|Jas.1:22]], al. (see Bl., §44, 2); οὐ (μὴ) μ., [[galatians 4 18|Gal.4:18]], [[james 1 22|Jas.1:22]]; οὐ μ. . . . ἀλλά (Bl, §77, 13.3), [[acts 19 26|Act.19:26]], [[1-john 5 6|1Jn.5:6]], al.; id. before καί (Bl., §81, 1.2), [[romans 5 3|Rom.5:3 9:10]], [[2-corinthians 8 19|2Co.8:19]], al.; (b) κατὰ μόνας, alone (Bl., §44, 1), [[mark 4 10|Mrk.4:10]], [[luke 9 18|Luk.9:18]]. (AS)
κατ-ανά-θεμα Rec. for κατάθεμα, q.v (AS)
κατα-θεματίζω to curse vehemently: [[matthew 26 74|Mat.26:74]] (cf. ἀναθεμ-).† (AS)
κατ-αν-αλίσκω [in LXX chiefly forאָכַל ;] 1. to use up, spend. 2. to consume: of fire, ptcp., [[hebrews 12 29|Heb.12:29]] (LXX).† (AS)

κατα-ναρκάω, -ῶ (ναρκάω, to grow numb, in LXX, in causal sense, for יָקַע, [[genesis 32 25|Gen.32:25]] (26); without Heb. equiv., [[genesis 32 32|Gen.32:32]] (33) [[job 33 19|Job.33:19]], Dan LXX 11:6*); 1. to cause to grow numb. 2. Intrans., to grow numb; hence metaphorically, to be inactive, be burdensome to with genitive, [[2-corinthians 11 9|2Co.11:9 12:13-14]]; pass., to be quite numb (Hippocr.).† (AS)
κατα-νεύω 1. to nod assent, 2. to make a sign by nodding the head: with dative of person(s), [[luke 5 7|Luk.5:7.]]† (AS)

κατα-νοέω, -ῶ [in LXX for נָבַט hi., רָאָה, etc. ;] to take note of, perceive, consider carefully: [[acts 7 31|Act.7:31-32;]] with accusative of thing(s), [[matthew 7 3|Mat.7:3]], [[luke 6 41|Luk.6:41 12:24, 27 20:23]], [[acts 11 6|Act.11:6 27:39]], [[romans 4 19|Rom.4:19]]; with accusative of person(s), [[hebrews 3 1|Heb.3:1 10:24]], [[james 1 23|Jas.1:23-24]] (on the distinction bet. κ. and νοέω simplex, see M, Pr., 117).† (AS)

κατ-αντάω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[2-samuel 3 29|2Ki.3:29]] (חוּל), 2Ma.4:21 2Mac 4:24 2Mac 4:44 2Mac 6:14 * ;] to come to, arrive at: before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[acts 16 1|Act.16:1 18:19, 24 21:7 25:13]] (see M, Pr., 132) [[acts 27 12|Act.27:12 28:13]]; before ἀντικρύ, with genitive, [[acts 20 15|Act.20:15.]] Metaphorical, before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), [[1-corinthians 10 11|1Co.10:11 14:36]]; id. with accusative of thing(s), to attain to: [[acts 26 7|Act.26:7]], [[ephesians 4 13|Eph.4:13]], [[philippians 3 11|Php.3:11]].† (AS)

κατά-νυξις, -εως, ἡ (κατανύσσω, which see), [in LXX: [[psalms 60 3|Psa.60:3]] (תַּרְעֵלָה), [[isaiah 29 10|Isa.29:10]] (תַּרְדֵּמָה)* ;] 1. a pricking. 2. (Perhaps through resembl. of κατανύσσω to -νυστάζω), torpor of mind, stupefaction: [[romans 11 8|Rom.11:8]] (LXX) (see ICC, in l; Field, Notes, 157).† (AS)

κατα-νύσσω [in LXX: [[genesis 34 7|Gen.34:7]] (עָצַב hith.), [[leviticus 10 3|Lev.10:3]], [[psalms 4 4|Psa.4:4]], [[psalms 29 12|Psa 29:12]], al. (דָּמַם), Dan LXX TH Sus 1:10 (רָדַם ni.), Sir.12:12 14:1, al. ;] 1. to strike or prick violently. 2. to stun. 3. Of strong emotion, pass., to be smitten: τὴν καρδίαν, [[acts 2 37|Act.2:37]] (see: κατάνυξις).† (AS)

κατ-αξιόω, -ῶ [in LXX: 2Ma.13:12, 3Ma.3:21 3Mac 4:11, 4Ma.18:3 * ;] to deem worthy: with accusative of person(s) and genitive of thing(s), [[2-thessalonians 1 5|2Th.1:5;]] pass. before inf., [[luke 20 35|Luk.20:35]], [[acts 5 41|Act.5:41]].† (AS)

κατα-πατέω, -ῶ [in LXX for דָּרַךְ, רָמַס, שָׁאַף, etc. ;] to tread down, trample under foot: [[matthew 7 6|Mat.7:6]], [[luke 12 1|Luk.12:1]]; pass., [[matthew 5 13|Mat.5:13]], [[luke 8 5|Luk.8:5]]. Metaphorical, τ. υἱὸν τ. θεοῦ, [[hebrews 10 29|Heb.10:29.]]† (AS)

κατά-παυσις, -εως, ἡ (καταπαύω), [in LXX chiefly for מְנוּחָה, [[psalms 95 11|Psa.95:11]], [[isaiah 66 1|Isa.66:1]], al.; ἡμέρα τῆς κ., 2Ma.15:1] 1. in cl., a putting to rest, causing to cease. 2. In LXX and NT, rest, repose: [[acts 7 49|Act.7:49]] (LXX), [[hebrews 3 11|Heb.3:11, 18 4:1, 3 4:5, 10-11]]† (AS)

κατα-παύω [in LXX for נוּחַ, שָׁבַת, etc. ;] 1. trans., (a) to cause to cease, restrain: [[acts 14 18|Act.14:18;]] (b) to cause to rest: [[hebrews 4 8|Heb.4:8.]] 2. Intrans., to rest: before ἀτό, [[hebrews 4 4|Heb.4:4]] (LXX), [[hebrews 4 10|Heb.4:10.]]† (AS)

κατα-πέτασμα, -τος, τό (= cl. παραπέτασμα) [in LXX chiefly for פֹּרֶכֶת (the veil of the Holy of Holies), [[exodus 26 31|Exo.26:31]], [[leviticus 21 23|Lev.21:23]], al.; also for מָסָךְ (the outer veil), [[exodus 35 12|Exo.35:12]], Num_3:26, al. (elsewhere κάλυμμα) ;] in NT always the inner veil or curtain of the Temple (or Tabernacle): [[matthew 27 51|Mat.27:51]], [[mark 15 38|Mrk.15:38]], [[luke 23 45|Luk.23:45]], [[hebrews 6 19|Heb.6:19 9:3]]; figuratively, ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ [[hebrews 10 20|Heb.10:20.]]† (AS)

κατα-πίνω [in LXX chiefly for בָּלַע ;] 1. to drink down, swallow: [[matthew 23 24|Mat.23:24]], [[revelation 12 16|Rev.12:16]]. 2. to devour: [[1-peter 5 8|1Pe.5:8.]] Metaphorical, to swallow up, consume: pass., [[1-corinthians 15 54|1Co.15:54]] (LXX), [[2-corinthians 2 7|2Co.2:7 5:4]], [[hebrews 11 29|Heb.11:29]].† (AS)
κατα-πίπτω [in LXX: [[psalms 145 14|Psa.145:14]] (נָפַל), etc. ;] to fall down: [[acts 28 6|Act.28:6;]] before εἰς, [[acts 26 14|Act.26:14;]] ἐπί with accusative, [[luke 8 6|Luk.8:6.]]† (AS)
κατα-πλέω, -ῶ to sail down, sail to land, put in: εἰς τ. χώραν, [[luke 8 26|Luk.8:26.]]† (AS)
κατα-πονέω, -ῶ [in LXX: 2Ma.8:2 (A), 3Ma.2:2 3Mac 2:13 * ;] to wear down, oppress, treat hardly: pass., [[acts 7 24|Act.7:24]], [[2-peter 2 7|2Pe.2:7]].† (AS)

κατα-πονίζω [in LXX for טָבַע pu., [[exodus 15 4|Exo.15:4]] A, בָּלַע pi., שָׁטַף, [[psalms 55 9|Psa.55:9 69:2]], al. ;] to throw into the sea, sink or drown therein: [[matthew 14 30|Mat.14:30;]] pass., [[matthew 18 6|Mat.18:6.]]† (AS)

κατ-άρα, -ας, -ἡ [in LXX chiefly for קְלָלָה ;] a curse: [[galatians 3 10|Gal.3:10, 13]] [[hebrews 6 8|Heb.6:8]], [[2-peter 2 14|2Pe.2:14]]; opposite to εὐλογία, [[james 3 10|Jas.3:10;]] concrete, of Christ, [[galatians 3 13|Gal.3:13]] (see Lft. in l).† (AS)

κατ-αράομαι, -ώμαι depon. (κατάρα), [in LXX chiefly for קָלַל pi. ;] to curse: with accusative, [[mark 11 21|Mrk.11:21;]] opposite to εὐλογέω, [[luke 6 26|Luk.6:26]], [[romans 12 14|Rom.12:14]], [[james 3 9|Jas.3:9]]; pass. pf. ptcp., accursed, under a curse (see M, Pr., 221): [[matthew 25 41|Mat.25:41.]]† (AS)

κατ-αργέω, -ῶ (κατά, causative, ἀργός = ἀ-εργός), [in LXX: 2Es.4.21; 2Es.4.23; 2Es.5.5; 2Es.6.8 (בְּטֵל)* ;] to make idle or inactive (χέρας, Eur., Phœn., 753): of soil occupied by an unfruitful tree, [[luke 13 7|Luk.13:7.]] Metaphorical (Inscr.), to render inoperative or invalid, to abrogate, abolish: [[romans 3 3|Rom.3:3, 31]], [[1-corinthians 1 28|1Co.1:28 6:13 13:11 15:24]], [[galatians 3 17|Gal.3:17]], [[ephesians 2 15|Eph.2:15]], [[2-thessalonians 2 8|2Th.2:8]], [[2-timothy 1 10|2Ti.1:10]], [[hebrews 2 14|Heb.2:14]]; pass., [[romans 4 14|Rom.4:14 6:6]], [[1-corinthians 2 6|1Co.2:6 13:8 13:10 15:26]], [[2-corinthians 3 7|2Co.3:7 3:11-14]] [[galatians 5 11|Gal.5:11]]; before ἀπό (of persons), to be separated, discharged or loosed from, [[romans 7 2|Rom.7:2]], 6, [[galatians 5 4|Gal.5:4]].† (AS)
κατ-αριθμέω, -ῶ [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 31 19|2Ch.31:19]] (יָחַשׂ hith.), al. ;] to number or count among: before ἐν, [[acts 1 1|Act.1:1.]]† (AS)

κατ-αρτίζω [in LXX chiefly in Ps ([[psalms 8 2|Psa.8:2]] al.; כּוּן, etc.) and Ezra (כְּלַל) ;] to render ἄρτιος, i.e. fit, complete; (a) to mend, repair: [[matthew 4 21|Mat.4:21]], [[mark 1 19|Mrk.1:19]]; (b) to furnish completely, complete, equip, prepare: pass., [[luke 6 40|Luk.6:40]], [[romans 9 22|Rom.9:22]], [[hebrews 11 3|Heb.11:3]]; mid., [[matthew 21 16|Mat.21:16]] (LXX), [[hebrews 10 5|Heb.10:5]] (LXX); (with) in ethical sense, to prepare, complete, perfect: [[galatians 6 1|Gal.6:1]] (EV, restore), [[1-peter 5 10|1Pe.5:10;]] pass., [[1-corinthians 1 10|1Co.1:10]] (Field, Notes, 167), [[2-corinthians 13 11|2Co.13:11]], [[hebrews 13 21|Heb.13:21]] (cf. προ-καταρτίζω).† (AS)
κατ-άρτισις, -εως, ἡ (καταρτίζω), a strengthening, making fit: in ethical sense, [[2-corinthians 13 9|2Co.13:9.]]† (AS)
καταρτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ [in Sm.: [[isaiah 38 12|Isa.38:12]] * ;] = κατάρτισις (but see ICC, Eph. l.with): [[ephesians 4 12|Eph.4:12.]]† (AS)

κατα-σείω [in LXX: Da TH Bel 1:14 AR, 1Ma.6:38 * ;] 1. to shake down. 2. Of the hand, to shake or wave as a signal: τ. χεῖρα, [[acts 19 33|Act.19:33;]] τ. χειρί, [[acts 13 16|Act.13:16;]] id. with dative of person(s), [[acts 21 40|Act.21:40;]] before inf., [[acts 12 17|Act.12:17.]]† (AS)
κατα-σκάπτω [in LXX for נָתַץ, הָרַס, etc. ;] to dig down: [[romans 11 3|Rom.11:3]] (LXX).† (AS)

κατα-σκευάζω [in LXX: [[isaiah 40 19|Isa.40:19, 28]], (בָּרָא), etc. ;] to prepare, make ready: τ. ὁδόν, [[matthew 11 10|Mat.11:10]], [[mark 1 2|Mrk.1:2]], [[luke 7 27|Luk.7:27]]; οἶκον, [[hebrews 3 3|Heb.3:3-4;]] σκηνήν, [[hebrews 9 2|Heb.9:2]], 6; κιβωτόν, [[hebrews 11 7|Heb.11:7]], [[1-peter 3 20|1Pe.3:20]]; pass. pf. ptcp., λαον κ., [[luke 1 17|Luk.1:17.]]† (AS)

κατα-σκηνόω, -ῶ [in LXX chiefly for סָכַךְ ;] to pitch one's tent, lodge, dwell: before ἐν, [[matthew 13 32|Mat.13:32]], [[luke 13 19|Luk.13:19]]; ὑπό, with accusative, [[mark 4 32|Mrk.4:32;]] ἐπ᾽ ἐλπιδι, [[acts 2 26|Act.2:26]] (LXX).† (AS)

κατα-σκήνωσις, εως, ἡ [in LXX: [[1-chronicles 28 2|1Ch.28:2]] (בָּנָה), [[ezekiel 37 27|Eze.37:27]] (מִשְׁכָּן) Tob.1:4, Wis.9:8, 2Ma.14:35 (R)* ;] 1. prop., an encamping, taking up one's quarters (Polyb., al., see LS; and cf. LXX, ll. with). 2. a lodging, abode: of birds, [[matthew 8 20|Mat.8:20]], [[luke 9 58|Luk.9:58]].† (AS)
κατα-σκιάζω to overshadow: with accusative, [[hebrews 9 5|Heb.9:5.]]† (AS)
κατα-σκοπέω, -ῶ [in LXX: 4Ki.10:3, [[1-chronicles 19 3|1Ch.19:3]] (רָגַל pi.), 1Ma.5:38 (A)* ;] to view closely, inspect, spy out: with accusative, [[galatians 2 4|Gal.2:4.]]† (AS)
κατά-σκοπος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX for רָגַל pi. ;] a spy: [[hebrews 11 31|Heb.11:31.]]† (AS)
κατα-σοφίζομαι [in LXX: [[exodus 1 10|Exo.1:10]] (חָכָם hith.), Jdth.5:11 10:19 * ;] to deal craftily with, outwit: [[acts 7 19|Act.7:19]] (LXX) † (AS)
κατα-στέλλω [in LXX: 2Ma.4:31, 3Ma.6:1 * ;] 1. to let down, lower. 2. to keep down, restrain: with accusative, [[acts 19 35|Act.19:35-36]] † (AS)
κατά-στημα, -τος, τό (καθίστημι), in LXX: 3Ma.5:45 (-εμα, A) * ;] 1. condition, of health, etc. 2. demeanour: [[titus 2 3|Tit.2:3]] (for exx. see Field, Notes, 220).† (AS)

κατα-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ (καταστέλλω), [in LXX: [[isaiah 61 3|Isa.61:3]] (מַעֲטֶה)* ;] 1. a letting down, checking. 2. steadiness, quietness in demeanour. 3. LXX and NT (cf. Plut., ii, 65 D; -ίζω = vestire), a garment, dress, attire: [[1-timothy 2 9|1Ti.2:9]] (but see Ellic., in l).† (AS)

κατα-στρέφω [in LXX for הָפַךְ, etc., [[genesis 19 21|Gen.19:21]], [[jeremiah 20 16|Jer.20:16]], al. ;] 1. to turn down, turn over; as, the soil. 2. to overturn, overthrow: [[matthew 21 12|Mat.21:12]], [[mark 11 15|Mrk.11:15]]; pass. pf. ptcp., [[acts 15 16|Act.15:16]] (LXX).† (AS)
κατα-στρηνιάω, -ῶ to wax wanton against: with genitive, [[1-timothy 5 11|1Ti.5:11]] (AS)

κατα-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ (καταστρέφω), [in LXX: [[job 21 17|Job.21:17]], [[proverbs 1 27|Pro.1:27]] (אֵיד), al. ;] 1. overthrow: [[2-peter 2 6|2Pe.2:6]] (WH, om.). 2. Metaphorical, subversion, upsetting (cf. καθαίρεσις, [[2-corinthians 13 10|2Co.13:10]]): [[2-timothy 2 14|2Ti.2:14]].† (AS)

κατα-στρώννυμι [in LXX: [[numbers 14 16|Num.14:16]] (שָׁחַט), [[job 12 23|Job.12:23]] (שָׁטַח), שָׁטַח), Jdt.4.1-15; Jdt.2.1-28 Mac.4 ;] 1. to strew or spread over. 2. to lay low, overthrow: [[1-corinthians 10 5|1Co.10:5.]]† (AS)

κατα-σύρω [in LXX: [[jeremiah 49 10|Jer.49:10]] (חָשַׂף), Dan LXX, [[daniel 11 10|Dan.11:10, 26]] (שָׁטַף) * ;] 1. to pull down. 2. to drag away: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 12 58|Luk.12:58.]]† (AS)
κατα-σφάζω [in LXX: [[zechariah 11 5|Zec.11:5]] (הָרַג), [[ezekiel 16 40|Eze.16:40]] (בָּתַק pi.), 2Ma.8:1-36 ;] to kill off, slay: with accusative, [[luke 19 27|Luk.19:27.]]† (AS)
κατα-σφραγίζω [in LXX: [[job 9 7|Job.9:7 37:7]] (חָתַם), Wis.2:5 * ;] to seal up, secure with a seal: [[revelation 5 1|Rev.5:1.]]† (AS)
κατά-σχεσις, -εως, ἡ (κατέχω), [in LXX nearly always for אֲחֻזָּה ] 1. a holding back. 2. LXX and NT, a holding fast, possession: [[acts 7 5|Act.7:5, 45]].† (AS)

κατα-τίθημι [in LXX: [[1-chronicles 21 27|1Ch.21:27]] שׁוּב hi.), [[psalms 41 8|Psa.41:8]] (יָצַק), 1Ma.10:23, al. ;] to lay down, deposit, lay by: [[mark 15 46|Mrk.15:46]], T; mid., to lay up for oneself: χάριν (Hdt., al., see LS, see word), with dative of person(s), [[acts 24 27|Act.24:27 25:9]].† (AS)

κατα-τομή, -ῆς, ἡ [in Sm.: [[jeremiah 31 37|Jer.31:37]] (κατατέμνω is used in LXX of forbidden mutilations: [[leviticus 21 5|Lev.21:5]], al.) ;] 1. incision. 2. excision, concision, mutilation: in sarcasm, by paronomasia, in contrast to (true) περιτομή (v3), of Judaizing Christians, [[philippians 3 2|Php.3:2]] (see Lft., in l; Cremer, 883).† (AS)
